description: The file defines a SwiftUI view 'CostUsageHistoryMenuView' that presents a cost usage history chart, along with helper utilities for date parsing/formatting related to cost usage data. It also specifies how data is displayed, formatted, and visualized in the UI.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout of the component, including header, chart, and footer sections.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Builds the header view displaying today's costs and total costs over recent days.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Creates a bar chart visualization of daily cost data.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: Displays a message if some cost entries are missing.
